integrity.first_public_date_basis: The archival orthogonal and Lagrangian preprints were both first submitted on 2003-06-24.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The archival orthogonal Grassmannian source is classified under 14M15 and 05E15, with 14M15 listed first.

scientific_limitations: The spinor degree uses the minimal half-spin embedding, not the orthogonal Pluecker embedding.
The theorem is a numerical projective-degree identity and does not construct a complex morphism between the two varieties.
An unindexed source could already contain the same comparison of the two classical product formulas.
title: A pure two-primary degree bridge between Lagrangian and spinor varieties
